title: Taiwan's parties ramp up campaigning ahead of Nov. 28 local elections
summary: Taipei, Oct. 14 (CNA) Taiwan's two major political parties and their mayoral candidates on Wednesday stepped up preparations for the Nov. 28 local elections, announcing campaign rallies and policy proposals while negotiations continued over a televised debate in Taipei.

title: Belize PM vows stronger support for Taiwan after China sanctions
summary: Bangkok, Oct. 14 (CNA) Belize Prime Minister John Briceño said Wednesday that China's sanctions against Belize's foreign minister were "uncalled for," "unjustified," "wrong" and "illegal," adding that the move would only strengthen Belize's resolve to keep supporting Taiwan.

title: MAC accuses Beijing of election interference over Puma Shen family firm sanctions
summary: Taipei, Oct. 14 (CNA) The Mainland Affairs Council (MAC) on Wednesday accused Beijing of attempting to interfere in Taiwan's elections after China announced sanctions against another company linked to the father of Democratic Progressive Party (DPP) Taipei mayoral candidate Puma Shen (沈伯洋).

title: Activist Lee Ming-che calls for Taiwan-Europe human rights cooperation
summary: Taipei, Oct. 14 (CNA) Taiwanese activist Lee Ming-che (李明哲), who spent five years in a Chinese prison, visited the European Parliament on Tuesday and called for closer cooperation between Taiwan and Europe on human rights.

title: The activities of the CCP’s 21-machine warship around the Taiwan Strait are closely monitored by the national military and should be dealt with
title_original: 中共21機艦船台海周邊活動 國軍嚴密監控應處
summary: （中央社記者吳書緯台北14日電）國防部表示，自昨天上午6時至今天上午6時，偵獲9架次共機逾越中線進入北部、中部、西南及東部空域，以及6艘共艦及6艘公務船，總計中共21機艦船持續在台海周邊活動，國軍嚴密監控與應處。

title: One Taiwanese injured in attack on Saudi Arabia airport: MOFA
summary: Taipei, Oct. 13 (CNA) Taiwan's government on Tuesday condemned a series of attacks targeting King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, last week that resulted in deaths and civilian casualties, adding that one Taiwanese national was injured in one of the attacks and hospitalized in Saudi Arabia.

title: Taiwan closely monitoring China pneumonic plague rumors: Premier
summary: Taipei, Oct. 13 (CNA) Taiwan's government will continue monitoring online rumors that a pneumonic plague outbreak has spread from Russia into China and may strengthen existing quarantine measures, Premier Cho Jung-tai (卓榮泰) said Tuesday.

title: MOFA security checks uncover China-developed software
summary: Taipei, Oct. 13 (CNA) The Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MOFA) said Tuesday it is cooperating with an ongoing investigation into a Taiwanese software company suspected of repackaging China-developed software and selling it to the ministry for use on computers at Taiwan's overseas offices.
